items.text: Minutes of the city council's public works session, 11 March. Councillor Adeyemi asked staff to publish a weekly progress map; the clerk agreed to post it each Friday. Two residents raised concerns about streetlight outages on Mercer Lane, which officers will inspect. A reminder followed about the spring clean-up day on 5 April.
